The archive is a GTFS-Flex feed of the location-group kind: one demand-responsive route over a
single location group of 120 stops, with two calendars, one booking rule and English romanisations
in `translations.txt`.

The feed is bundled **verbatim as the published archive**, not unpacked and not re-zipped, so the
sha256 above is the hash of the file as retrieved.

*Note: the archive filename carries `20260202` while the feed's own `feed_info.feed_version` is
`20260215`. Both are recorded as found; neither is corrected.*
